title: Two strings to her bow.
html_source: Provide a reserve that can be called upon in case of an emergency. In this case Bloom is thinking that the woman could be on the lookout for other men.

anchor.prefix: stone probably. High brown boots with laces dangling. Wellturned foot. What is he foostering over that change for? Sees me looking. Eye out for other fellow always. Good fallback.
anchor.suffix:
— Why? I said. What's wrong with him? I said. 

 Proud: rich: silk stockings. 

 — Yes, Mr Bloom said. 

1986#60

 He moved a little to the side of M'Coy's talking head. Gettin
